answer: Stake real value before agents can act, so fake identities pay a real price to enter. Each new node bonds funds at the inlet of the nebula, and that stake stays locked while it works, creating a clear cost for anyone trying to flood the system with duplicates. Honest agents earn from the shared orchard of fees and tasks, while the rare defector in a cluster of churned accounts loses its bond and reputation along with the chance to farm again, making each extra identity unattractive to operate.
